## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Translation (`i18n:`)
- [ ] Refactor / chore (`chore:` / `refactor:`)
- [ ] Build / CI (`build:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes locally
- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (or justified in this PR)
- [ ] All user-facing strings go through `t()` (`src/i18n`)
- [ ] Dynamic strings are escaped with `escapeHtml()`
- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and follow the
      [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
